title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Forms of Maritime Litigation Documents (for Trial Implementation) (Continued)
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the "Model Forms for Maritime Litigation Documents (For Trial Implementation)"

(Continued from Previous Issue)

V. Maritime Trial Procedure Category

Form No. 34

People's Republic of China XX (Maritime) Court

Decision on Change of Party

(XXXX) XX Fa Chu Zi No. XX

To XXX:

In the course of hearing this case ... (state the parties and the cause of action), the insurer XXX (state the applicant's name) of the party XXX (state the name or title of the party), on the ground that it has paid all claims within the coverage, requests to change the party (or to participate in the proceedings as a co-party) to exercise the rights of XXX (state the name of the party) by subrogation.

Upon examination, this Court finds that ... (state the reasons for granting or denying the applicant's request). Pursuant to Article 95 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, it is decided as follows:

The applicant XXX's request is granted. Party XXX shall withdraw from the proceedings, and the applicant XXX is changed to the plaintiff. (If the conditions for joinder are met, the preceding sentence shall be rewritten as: "The applicant XXX shall participate in the proceedings as a co-plaintiff.")

(If the subrogation conditions are not met, the content of the above decision shall be rewritten as: "The applicant XXX's request does not comply with the legal provisions; this Court does not grant it.")

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

Explanation

This form is to be used by maritime courts and their appellate courts when examining whether an insurer's application meets the conditions for subrogation proceedings.

Form No. 35

People's Republic of China XX (Maritime) Court

Notice of Joinder in Proceedings

(Notice to Shipowner in Oil Pollution Cases)

(XXXX) XX Fa Chu Zi No. XX

To XXX (state the shipowner's name):

In this case accepted by this Court ... (state the parties and the cause of action), because XXX (shipowner) is the owner of the vessel "XX", pursuant to Article 97(2) of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, XXX (shipowner) is hereby notified to participate in these proceedings as ... (state the litigation status after joining).

It is hereby notified.

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

Explanation:

This notice is to be used by maritime courts and appellate courts after accepting an oil pollution damage case, to notify the eligible shipowner to participate in the proceedings.

Form No. 36

People's Republic of China XX Maritime Court

Notice of Acceptance of Application for Payment Order

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Du Zi No. XX

To XXX (state the name or title of the applicant):

XXX (applicant) requests this Court to issue a payment order to XXX (state the name or title of the respondent). Upon examination, this Court finds that the application of XXX (applicant) meets the conditions set forth in Article 99 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and this Court decides to accept the application.

XXX (applicant) shall, upon receipt of this notice, prepay an application fee of ... yuan to this Court.

This Court's bank account: ______ Account number: ______

It is hereby notified.

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

Explanation:

This notice form is to be used by a maritime court when, after receiving an application for a payment order based on a maritime matter, it examines and decides to accept the application, and notifies the applicant accordingly.

Form No. 37

People's Republic of China XX Maritime Court

Notice of Non-Acceptance of Application for Payment Order

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Du Zi No. XX

To XXX (state the name or title of the applicant):

XXX (applicant) requests this Court to issue a payment order to XXX (state the name or title of the respondent). Upon examination, this Court finds that the application of XXX (applicant) does not meet the conditions set forth in Article 99 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and this Court decides not to accept the application.

It is hereby notified.

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

Explanation:

This notice form is to be used by a maritime court when, after receiving an application for a payment order based on a maritime matter, it examines and decides not to accept the application, and notifies the applicant accordingly.

Form No. 38

People's Republic of China XX Maritime Court

Payment Order

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Du Zi No. XX

Applicant ... (state basic information such as name or title).

Respondent ... (state basic information such as name or title).

On ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day, the applicant XXX applied to this Court for a payment order. ... (briefly state the facts and evidence of the maritime claim provided by the applicant), requesting the respondent XXX to pay ... (state the type and amount of money or negotiable instruments claimed).

Upon examination, this Court finds that the applicant's application meets the conditions set forth in Article 99 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China. Pursuant to Article 191 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the following payment order is hereby issued:

The respondent XXX shall, within fifteen days from the date of receipt of this payment order, pay to the applicant ... (state the type and amount of money or negotiable instruments to be paid), and bear the case acceptance fee of ... yuan.

If the respondent has an objection, they shall submit a written objection to this Court within fifteen days from the date of receipt of this payment order; if no written objection is submitted within that period, this payment order shall become legally effective.

Judge: XXX

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

This document is verified to be identical to the original.

Clerk: XXX

Explanation:

This form is to be used by a maritime court with jurisdiction when, after accepting an application for a payment order, it examines and finds that the statutory conditions are met, and decides to issue a payment order to the respondent.

Form No. 39

People's Republic of China XX Maritime Court

Civil Ruling

(For Dismissal of Application for Payment Order)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Du Zi No. X

Applicant ... (state basic information such as name or title, and domicile).

Respondent ... (state basic information such as name or title, and domicile).

On ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day, the applicant XXX applied to this Court for a payment order. Upon examination, this Court finds that ... (state the reasons why the application is not established). Pursuant to Article 191(1) and Article 140(1)(11) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, it is ruled as follows:

The application for a payment order by XXX is dismissed.

The case acceptance fee of ... yuan shall be borne by the applicant XXX.

This ruling is final.

Judge: XXX

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

This document is verified to be identical to the original.

Clerk: XXX

Explanation:

1. This civil ruling form is to be used by a maritime court when, after accepting a case of an application for a payment order by a maritime claim creditor, it examines and finds that the conditions set forth in Article 99 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China are not met, and decides to dismiss the application.

2. If the applicant or respondent is a legal person or other organization, their basic information shall include the name and address, and below that, a separate line for the legal representative or representative shall be added, stating his/her name and position. If the applicant or respondent is a natural person, their basic information shall include name, gender, date of birth, ethnicity, place of origin, occupation or work unit and position, and address. If the applicant or respondent has an agent ad litem, the agent ad litem item shall be listed on a separate line below, stating his/her name, gender, occupation or work unit and position.

Form No. 40

People's Republic of China XX Maritime Court

Civil Ruling

(For Termination of Supervision Procedure)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Du Zi No. XX

Applicant ... (state basic information such as name or title, and domicile).

Respondent ... (state basic information such as name or title, and domicile).

After accepting the application for a payment order by the applicant XXX, this Court issued a payment order on ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day, (XXXX) X Hai Fa Du Zi No. XX, ordering the respondent XXX to satisfy the debt within fifteen days from the date of receipt of the payment order, or to submit a written objection to this Court. The respondent XXX has submitted a written objection within the prescribed period. Pursuant to Articles 192 and 140(1)(11) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, it is ruled as follows:

The supervision procedure in this case is terminated.

The payment order issued by this Court on ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day, (XXXX) X Hai Fa Du Zi No. XX, shall automatically become invalid. The applicant XXX may file a lawsuit in accordance with the law.

The case acceptance fee of ... yuan shall be borne by the applicant XXX.

This ruling is final.

Judge: XXX

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

This document is verified to be identical to the original.

Clerk: XXX

Explanation:

This ruling form is to be used by a maritime court when, after accepting a case of an application for a payment order based on a maritime matter and issuing a payment order, the debtor submits a written objection within the prescribed period, and the supervision procedure is terminated in accordance with the law.

Form No. 41

People's Republic of China XX Maritime Court

Civil Ruling

(For Termination of Supervision Procedure Due to Withdrawal of Application)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Du Zi No. XX

Applicant ... (state basic information such as name or title, and domicile).

Respondent ... (state basic information such as name or title, and domicile).

After accepting the application for a payment order by the applicant XXX, the applicant XXX, due to ... (state the reason for withdrawal of the application), withdrew the application for a payment order from this Court on ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day.

This Court finds that the withdrawal of the application by the applicant XXX for legitimate reasons before the payment order is served on the respondent is in compliance with the law and shall be permitted. Pursuant to Article 140(1)(11) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, it is ruled as follows:

The supervision procedure in this case is terminated.

The case acceptance fee of ... yuan shall be borne by the applicant XXX.

This ruling is final.

Judge: XXX

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

This document is verified to be identical to the original.

Clerk: XXX

Explanation:

This ruling form is to be used by a maritime court when, after accepting a case of an application for a payment order based on a maritime matter, the applicant withdraws the application before the payment order is served on the respondent, and the supervision procedure is terminated in accordance with the law.

Form No. 42

People's Republic of China XX Maritime Court

Notice of Acceptance of Application for Maritime Public Summons

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Cui Zi No. XX

To XXX (state the name or title of the applicant for public summons):

XXX (applicant) applied to this Court for a public summons. Upon examination, this Court finds that the application of XXX (applicant) meets the conditions set forth in Article 100 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and this Court decides to accept the application. XXX (applicant) shall, within seven days after receiving this notice, prepay an application fee of ... yuan to this Court.

This Court's bank account: ______ Account number: ______

It is hereby notified.

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

Explanation:

This notice form is to be used by a maritime court when, after receiving an application for a maritime public summons, it examines and decides to accept it, and notifies the applicant accordingly.

Form No. 43

People's Republic of China XX Maritime Court

Civil Ruling

(For Dismissal of Application for Public Summons)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Cui Zi No. XX

Applicant XXX (state name or title, and domicile, etc.).

The applicant XXX applied to this Court for a public summons. Upon examination, this Court finds that ... (state the reasons why the application is not established). Pursuant to Article 100 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, it is ruled as follows:

The application for a public summons by the applicant XXX is dismissed.

The case acceptance fee of ... yuan shall be borne by the applicant XXX.

This ruling is final.

Judge: XXX

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

This document is verified to be identical to the original.

Clerk: XXX

Explanation:

This form is to be used by a maritime court when, after accepting a case of an application for a maritime public summons, it examines and finds that the conditions set forth in Article 100 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China are not met, and decides to dismiss the application.

Form No. 44

People's Republic of China XX Maritime Court

Notice to Stop Delivery of Goods

(For Maritime Public Summons Procedure)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Cui Zi No. XX

To XXX (state the name of the carrier or agent):

The applicant XXX, due to ... (state the name of the relevant document of title and the circumstances of loss of control or loss, etc.), applied to this Court for a public summons, and this Court decided to accept it. Pursuant to Article 100 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Articles 194 and 195 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, XXX (carrier or agent) is hereby notified to immediately stop delivery of the goods under ... (state the name of the document of title, the value of the goods, and the name or title of the issuer, holder, endorser, etc.), pending a ruling or judgment by this Court.

It is hereby notified.

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

Explanation:

This notice form is to be used by a maritime court after deciding to accept the application for a public summons by the holder of a document of title, to notify the carrier or its agent to stop delivery of the goods.

Form No. 45

People's Republic of China XX Maritime Court

Civil Ruling

(For Termination of Maritime Public Summons Procedure)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Cui Zi No. XX

Applicant ... (state name or title, and domicile, etc.).

Claimant ... (state name or title, and domicile, etc.).

The applicant XXX, due to ... (state the document of title and the circumstances of its loss of control or loss), applied to this Court for a public summons. After accepting the application, this Court published a notice on ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day, urging interested parties to claim their rights within × days. Now, the claimant XXX has claimed rights before this Court within the prescribed period. Pursuant to Articles 196(2) and (3) and Article 140(1)(11) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, it is ruled as follows:

1. The public summons procedure in this case is terminated.

2. The applicant (or the claimant) may file a lawsuit with a maritime court.

3. The case acceptance fee and publication fee of ... yuan shall be borne by the applicant XXX.

This ruling is final.

Judge: XXX

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

This document is verified to be identical to the original.

Clerk: XXX

Explanation:

1. This form is to be used by a maritime court when, after accepting a maritime public summons case and publishing a notice urging interested parties to claim their rights, it receives a claim from an interested party within the prescribed period, and terminates the public summons procedure in accordance with the law.

2. This ruling shall be served on the applicant and the carrier or its agent.

Form No. 46

People's Republic of China XX Maritime Court

Civil Judgment

(For Exclusion of Rights in Public Summons)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Cui Zi No. XX

Applicant ... (state name or title, and domicile, etc.).

The applicant XXX applied for a declaration of invalidity of the document of title. After accepting the case, this Court published a notice on ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day in accordance with the law, urging interested parties to claim their rights within × days. The period of the public summons has now expired, and no claim has been filed with this Court. Pursuant to Article 197 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, it is adjudged as follows:

1. ... (state the name of the document of title, the value of the goods, and the issuer, holder, endorser, etc.) is declared invalid;

2. As of the date of publication of this judgment, the applicant XXX is entitled to claim delivery of the goods from the carrier XXX.

The case acceptance fee and publication fee of ... yuan shall be borne by the applicant XXX.

This judgment is final.

Judge: XXX

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

This document is verified to be identical to the original.

Clerk: XXX

Explanation:

This judgment form is to be used by a maritime court when, after accepting a maritime public summons case and publishing a notice urging interested parties to claim their rights, no claim is filed within the prescribed period, and the document of title is declared invalid in accordance with the law.

Form No. 47

People's Republic of China XX Maritime Court

Notice

(For Public Summons Procedure)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Cui Zi No. XX

The applicant XXX, due to ... (state the name and main content of the document of title that has been lost or lost of control, and the reasons for the application), applied to this Court for a public summons, and this Court decided to accept it. Pursuant to Article 194 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, notice is hereby given. Within × days from the date of this notice, interested parties shall claim their rights before this Court. If no claim is made by then, this Court will render a judgment in accordance with the law, declaring the above document of title invalid. Any transfer of the document of title during the period of the public summons shall be void.

It is hereby announced.

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

Explanation:

This notice form is to be used by a maritime court after accepting a maritime public summons case, to publish a notice by newspaper or posting within three days, urging interested parties to claim their rights regarding the lost or lost-of-control document of title or other matters.

Form No. 48

People's Republic of China XX Maritime Court

Notice

(For Public Summons Procedure: Announcement of Judgment)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Cui Zi No. XX

This Court accepted the application for a public summons by the applicant XXX on ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day, and handled the public summons procedures in accordance with the law regarding the lost (or lost-of-control) document of title ... (state the name of the document of title, the value of the goods, and the main content of the issuer, holder, endorser, etc.). No claim was made during the period of the public summons. This Court rendered a civil judgment on ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day, (XXXX) X Hai Fa Cui Zi No. XX, declaring the above document of title invalid. As of the date of this notice, the applicant XXX is entitled to claim delivery of the goods under the above document of title.

It is hereby announced.

(Date: ___ Year ___ Month ___ Day)

(Court Seal)

Explanation:

This notice form is to be used by a maritime court when, after the period of the maritime public summons expires, it announces by notice the judgment declaring the document of title invalid.

VI. Procedure for Establishing a Fund for Limitation of Liability for Maritime Claims

Form No. 49

People's Republic of China XX Maritime Court

Notice of Acceptance of Application

(For Notifying the Applicant to Establish a Fund for Limitation of Liability for Maritime Claims)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Xian Zi No. XX

To XXX (state the name of the applicant for establishing the fund):

XXX (Applicant) has submitted an application to this Court for the establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund. Upon review, this Court finds that the application of XXX (Applicant) complies with the provisions of Article ... paragraph ... of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and decides to accept it.

XXX (Applicant) shall, within seven days of receipt of this Notice, pay to this Court an application fee of ... yuan. Bank of this Court: Account number:

Notice is hereby given.

XXXX年XX月XX日

(Court Seal)

Form No. 50

Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Public Notice

(For notifying unknown interested parties)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Xian Zi No. X

On XXXX年XX月XX日, this Court lawfully accepted the application submitted by the applicant XXX for the establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund. The applicant XXX alleges that: ... (state the facts and reasons for the application, and the request for establishment of the fund). Any interested party related to this maritime accident who has an objection to the applicant XXX's application for establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund shall, within thirty days from the date of this public notice, submit a written objection to this Court; any party who has no objection to the applicant XXX's application for establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund, or whose objection has been rejected by a ruling of this Court, shall, within X days from the date of this public notice, register maritime claims with this Court. Failure to register within the time limit shall be deemed as waiver of the claim, and such claim shall not be satisfied from the fund.

Notice is hereby given.

XXXX年XX月XX日

(Court Seal)

Form No. 51

Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Notice of Objection

(For notifying known interested parties to raise objections)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Xian Zi No. X

XXX (Name of known interested party):

On XXXX年XX月XX日, this Court lawfully accepted the application submitted by the applicant XXX for the establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund. The applicant XXX alleges that: ... (state the facts and reasons for the application, and the request for establishment of the fund). According to the list of known interested parties provided by the applicant XXX, XXX (known interested party), as an interested party related to this maritime accident, who has an objection to the applicant XXX's application for establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund shall, within seven days from the date of receipt of this Notice, submit a written objection to this Court; any party who has no objection to the applicant XXX's application for establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund, or whose objection has been rejected by a ruling of this Court, shall, within X days from the date of this public notice, register maritime claims with this Court. Failure to register within the time limit shall be deemed as waiver of the claim, and such claim shall not be satisfied from the fund.

Notice is hereby given.

XXXX年XX月XX日

(Court Seal)

Form No. 52

Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Civil Ruling

(For granting or rejecting an application for establishment of a fund at first instance)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Xian Zi No. X

Applicant: ... (state name or title, nationality, domicile and other basic information).

Objector: ... (state name or title, nationality, domicile and other basic information).

(If there is no objector, then omit; if there are multiple objectors, list them one by one)

On XXXX年XX月XX日, the applicant XXX applied to this Court for the establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund. After acceptance, this Court issued notices to the relevant interested parties and, on XXXX年XX月XX日, published a public notice in ... (state the scope of the public notice). On XXXX年XX月XX日, the objector XXX filed an objection with this Court. (If no objection is raised, then omit.)

The applicant XXX alleges that: ... (state the facts and reasons for the applicant's application, and the request for establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund), and has provided evidence materials such as ... .

The objector XXX alleges that: ... (state the facts and reasons for the objector's objection), and has provided evidence materials such as ... . (If no objection is raised, then omit.)

Upon review, this Court finds that ... (state the reasons for the validity or invalidity of the objection, the reasons for granting or denying the establishment of the fund, and the reasons for the amount of the fund to be established). Pursuant to Article 106, paragraph 2 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the ruling is as follows:

1. Reject the objection of the objector XXX (if no objection is raised, then omit);
2. Grant the application of the applicant XXX for the establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund;
3. The applicant XXX shall, within X days from the date of service of this ruling, establish with this Court a maritime liability limitation fund equivalent to its total limitation amount of ... (state the type of currency and amount). (If the objection is sustained, then the above ruling content shall be changed to: "Reject the application of the applicant XXX for the establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund.")

If dissatisfied with this ruling, you may, within seven days from the date of service of the ruling, submit an appeal and X copies to this Court, and appeal to the Higher People's Court of XXX.

Presiding Judge: XXX
Judge: XXX
Judge: XXX

XXXX年XX月XX日

(Court Seal)

This document is confirmed to be identical to the original.

Clerk: XXX

Form No. 53

Higher People's Court of the People's Republic of China

Civil Ruling

(For cases on appeal regarding establishment of a fund)

(XXXX) X Fa Xian Zi No. X

Appellant: ... (state name or title, domicile and other basic information).

Respondent: ... (state name or title, domicile and other basic information).

The appellant XXX, dissatisfied with the civil ruling (XXXX) X Hai Fa Xian Zi No. X of the XX Maritime Court regarding the application of XXX for the establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund, has appealed to this Court.

... (state the reasons and result of the original ruling, the appellant's appeal requests and reasons, and the respondent's defense).

Upon review, this Court finds that ... (state the reasons for dismissing the appeal or reversing the original ruling). Pursuant to Article 106, paragraph 3 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the ruling is as follows:

Dismiss the appeal and affirm the original ruling.

(If the appeal grounds are sustained, then the above ruling content shall be changed to: "1. Reverse the civil ruling (XXXX) X Hai Fa Xian Zi No. X of the XX Maritime Court; 2. Reject the application of the applicant XXX for the establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund." Or if the appellant is the applicant, change to: "Grant the application of the appellant XXX for the establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund.")

This ruling is final.

Presiding Judge: XXX
Judge: XXX
Judge: XXX

XXXX年XX月XX日

(Court Seal)

This document is confirmed to be identical to the original.

Clerk: XXX

VII. Procedures for Registration of Claims and Satisfaction

Form No. 54

Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Notice of Acceptance of Application for Registration of Claims

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Deng Zi No. X

XXX (Name or title of the applicant for registration of claims):

XXX (Applicant) submitted an application for registration of claims during the period of the public notice for the auction of the "XX" vessel by ruling of this Court (or during the period of the public notice for the acceptance of the application for the establishment of a maritime liability limitation fund issued by this Court). Upon review, this Court finds that the application for registration of claims of XXX (Applicant) complies with the provisions of Article 111 (or Article 112) of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and this Court decides to accept it.

XXX (Applicant) shall, within seven days after receipt of this Notice, prepay an application fee of ... yuan to this Court.

Bank: Account number:

Notice is hereby given.

XXXX年XX月XX日

(Court Seal)

Explanation:

This Notice form is for use by a maritime court when, after review and decision to accept an application for registration of claims, notifying the applicant.

Form No. 55

Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Civil Ruling

(For granting an application for registration of claims)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Deng Zi No. X

Applicant: ... (state name or title, domicile and other basic information).

On XXXX年XX月XX日, the applicant XXX applied to this Court for registration of claims on the grounds of ... (state the reasons for the application for registration of claims), requesting ... (state the specific request for registration of claims), and provided documents such as ... (or evidence).

Upon review, this Court finds that ... (state the reasons for granting the application for registration of claims). Pursuant to Article 114 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the ruling is as follows:

Grant the application of the applicant XXX for registration of claims.

Registration fee of ... yuan shall be paid by the applicant XXX.

This ruling is final.

Judge: XXX

XXXX年XX月XX日

(Court Seal)

This document is confirmed to be identical to the original.

Clerk: XXX

Form No. 56

Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Civil Ruling

(For rejecting an application for registration of claims)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Deng Zi No. X

Applicant: ... (state name or title, domicile and other basic information).

On XXXX年XX月XX日, the applicant XXX applied to this Court for registration of claims on the grounds of ... (state the reasons for the application for registration of claims), requesting ... (state the specific request for registration of claims), and provided documents such as ... .

Upon review, this Court finds that ... (state the reasons for not granting the registration of claims). Pursuant to Article 114 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the ruling is as follows:

Reject the application of the applicant XXX for registration of claims.

Registration fee of XX yuan shall be paid by the applicant XXX.

This ruling is final.

If dissatisfied with this ruling, you may apply to this Court for reconsideration once within X days from the date of service of the ruling. Execution of the ruling shall not be suspended during the period of reconsideration.

Judge: XXX

XXXX年XX月XX日

(Court Seal)

This document is confirmed to be identical to the original.

Clerk: XXX

Form No. 57

Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Civil Ruling

(For confirming claims)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa Deng Zi No. X

Applicant: ... (state name or title, domicile and other basic information).

On XXXX年XX月XX日, the applicant XXX applied to this Court for registration of claims on the grounds of ... (state the reasons for the application for registration of claims). By civil ruling (XXXX) X Hai Fa Deng Zi No. X dated XXXX年XX月XX日, this Court granted the application of the applicant XXX for registration of claims of ... .

Upon review of the documents provided by the applicant XXX (list the documents provided by the creditor), this Court finds that the said documents are authentic and lawful. Pursuant to Article 115 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the ruling is as follows:

The claims of ... applied for registration by the applicant XXX are hereby confirmed.

Judge: XXX

XXXX年XX月XX日

(Court Seal)

This document is confirmed to be identical to the original.

Clerk: XXX

Form No. 58

Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Civil Judgment

(For confirmation actions)

(XXXX) X Hai Fa X Zi No. X

Plaintiff: ... (state name or title, domicile and other basic information).

Legal representative (or representative): ... (state name and position).

Agent ad litem: ... (state name and other basic information).

Defendant: ... (state name or title, domicile and other basic information).

Legal representative (or representative): ... (state name or position).

Agent ad litem: ... (state name and other basic information).

Third party: ... (state name or title, domicile and other basic information).

Legal representative (or representative): ... (state name and position).

Agent ad litem: ... (state name and other basic information).

After completing the registration of claims with this Court, the plaintiff XXX filed a confirmation action against the defendant ... (state name and cause of action). After acceptance, this Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law (or the case was tried by a single judge, Judge XXX) and held a hearing in open (or closed) court. ... (state the parties and their agents ad litem, etc.) appeared in court. The case has now been concluded.

The plaintiff XXX alleges that: ... (summarize the specific claims and the facts and reasons relied upon by the plaintiff).
